title: Capcom transforms its RE Engine into an 'AI generation engine' for future games
summary: The company announces that artificial intelligence will be essential in the development of its next projects, evolving its proprietary technology.

title: The Coalition explains changes in Gears of War: E-Day and its bet on visceral violence
summary: The new title does away with classic features but reinforces gore and brutality to avoid player desensitization.

title: Jagex announces RuneScape 4, a full MMO sequel born from the Dragonwilds expansion
summary: The new game was revealed at RuneFest as an evolution of the survival project, marking the future of the franchise.

title: The Witcher 3 Remastered reaches a new all-time peak of concurrent players on Steam
summary: The next-gen update revitalizes CD Projekt Red's RPG, surpassing concurrency records and dividing opinions on its artistic direction.

title: Editorial and community share their weekend gaming experiences across multiple outlets
summary: Eurogamer, Rock Paper Shotgun, and Nintendo Life publish their usual recommendation and current play columns.

title: Valorant player reports hardware ban inherited from second-hand CPU; Riot clarifies the story
summary: The controversy arises after the purchase of a used processor that carried over sanctions from the previous owner, sparking debate about the anti-cheat system.

title: Activision and Bethesda send cease-and-desist letters to creators of AI recreations of Modern Warfare 2 and Fallout
summary: Both publishers pursue AI-generated projects that replicate their games, defending their intellectual property.

title: Deadlock consolidates among the top three most-played games on Steam and stands out for its New York-style hero design
summary: Valve's MOBA reaches record concurrent figures and receives praise for its characters' personality, such as the new Rat King.

title: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth director defends his vision and fights for a full disc release
summary: Naoki Hamaguchi states he avoided turning the remake into a personal project and advocated for the physical edition despite technical limitations.
